oneOf.description: A keep or deleted module with previous concrete implementation.

type.description: 'keep': The module has previous CONCRETE code implementation, that module is not changed in the new design. 'deleted': The module has previous CONCRETE code implementation, that module is not longer present in the current design.

module_name.description: The name of the module that follows pydeps convention.

responsibility.description: A sentence describing the single responsibility of this module.

oneOf.description: A new or changed module currently proposed, with more detailed designs.

type.description: 'changed': The module has previous CONCRETE code implementation, that module is changed in the current design. 'new': The module has NO previous CONCRETE code implementation, it is freshly proposed in the current design, even when it is updated in later iterations in revising the design.

module_name.description: The name of the module that follows pydeps convention.

responsibility.description: A sentence describing the single responsibility of this module.

non_responsibilities.description: A list of things that this module explicitly does not do, to ensure single responsibility principle.

inputs.description: A list of data structures for the inputs of this module.

outputs.description: A list of data structures for the outputs of this module.

public_interface.description: The public interface that is exposed to other modules, represented by a list of public methods.

description.description: A description of what this method does.

returns.description: The return type of the method.

preconditions.description: Conditions that should hold true before execution of the method.

postconditions.description: Conditions that should hold true after the method returns.
